titulo: Rapists could face life in prison and barristers be prevented from ‘putting victims on trial’ under Victorian Labor reforms
cuerpo: Premier Ben Carroll says if re-elected Labor will legislate a new form of manslaughter and increase maximum penalty for rape to life imprisonment Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Rapists could face life sentences and lawyers would be prevented from asking humiliating questions of victim-survivors under a suite of Victorian Labor pre-election commitments designed to reduce violence against women. The premier, Ben Carroll, on Sunday announced an election commitment to legislate a new form of manslaughter covering cases in which a person takes their own life as a result of family violence, as well as a new offence covering perpetrators abandoning a victim in need of medical care.
